name: Silver
description: Unique paint made our of silver fibers and secret nano-ingridients, developed in the top research facilities. This paint cannot be bought in the Garage for any amount of crystals, and the paint is given only to players with outstanding achievements in eSports battles.
interestingFacts: Players who receive this paint will also receive a unique Spectrum M module with  25% protection against all turrets and mines.
Paint appeared on June 18, 2013 (update 163).
The paint was issued to the silver medalists of the Inter-Clan Championship.

Until June 3, 2014, the paint had the following protections:
Twins - 30%
Railgun - 30%
Thunder - 25%
Smoky - 25%
Shaft - 20%
Ricochet - 20%.
With the transition of eSports competitions to StarLadder, the paint began to stand out for 2nd place in the Star Series and gained 22% protection from all turrets.
With the release of new protective paints on January 29 and February 6, 2015, the paint acquired protections from the Hammer, Vulcan, and mines.
On January 11, 2016, paint was removed from garages from the latest Silver Series Star medalists - the eGuards clan.
On June 4, 2016, the paint was issued to the silver medalist of the Masters of the Sword tournament - the All Kind clan.
On July 14, 2016, the paint lost its protections due to the separation of paints and protective modules.
On December 24, 2016, the paint was issued to the silver medalists of the Interclan Championship 9 tournament - the Can't Stop clan.
On November 27, 2017, the paint was issued to the silver medalists of the Interclan Championship X tournament - the Vavilon clan.
On November 26, 2018, the paint was issued to the silver medalists of the XI Clan Championship tournament - the Synergy clan.
On November 27, 2019, the paint was issued to the silver medalists of the XII Clan Championship tournament - the Can't Stop clan.
On November 27, 2020, the paint was issued to the silver medalists of the XIII Clan Championship tournament - the Team Pointers clan.
After April 23, 2021 (update 644), the Silver paint was paired with an updated Spectrum M module that provided 25% protection against all turrets and mines.
At the moment, Silver can be earned by placing second in one of the Major eSports Tournaments.
